description: Catcher alone (P5, Quencher, Æthertech ×4) vs Rhodagn, which attacks at 1, 12 and 23 s (its clock: time stops and slow-downs delay them) and charges a skill at 7 s; she starts with her ultimate charged. Battle skills the attack catches (frames 0–45) counter: the playhead jumps to 60, the bash lands at 83 (1 Vulnerable, P1 strike, Æthertech layer) and the action ends at 194; the one cast at 2.17 s in the counter's recast window (95–129) isn't attacked, so it jumps 45 → 255 and holds her 2.5 s. The charge opens the combo window (shield: P5 SP on the next bash, which also uses the combo's Link). The ultimate adds Weakness, a Knock Down and three shockwaves (talent 2 at level 2), each hit with a P1 strike; the last bash brings the enemy to 4 Vulnerable (Æthertech's extra bonus). The ultimate after the second counter has an explicit time (written before the gate saw the counter path's end, gap K2, since fixed).
